decision_source.summary: One composition per raid that optimizes raid buffs and debuffs; Blood DK tank, Feral druid as second tank, Resto shaman as third healer.

buff_coverage_declared.note: Copied verbatim from the decision document, for the Beast Mastery hunter with an exotic Worm (Acid Spit); superseded by survival_recheck. That pet was never provisioned: the BM bots got the catalog wolf (entry 8959, Furious Howl), so no live BM run had the 4% physical debuff.

survival_recheck.decision: User decision: the canonical hunter is Survival (the accepted, qualified hunter spec; the fixed Magmaw baiter). As BM it did 14-16k because Cobra Shot cannot be cast while moving; the legacy Survival baiter did 37.6k.
survival_recheck.method: Recomputed against the 23 categories of RAID_BUFFS_CONFIG (16) and DEBUFFS_CONFIG (7) of the same provider file and revision. Pet providers are the CreatureFamily skill-line abilities (SkillLineAbility) whose SpellEffect aura, misc value and amount equal the WoWSims representative (Acid Spit 55749: aura 87, physical, +4; Stampede 57386: aura 255, +30 bleed; Furious Howl 24604: aura 290, +5 crit). Exotic families (creature_template type_flags 0x10000: Worm 42, Rhino 43, Core Hound, Devilsaur, Spirit Beast, Silithid, Chimaera, Shale Spider) need the Beast Mastery talent 53270, so a Survival hunter cannot use them.

hunter_delta.lost_with_beast_mastery: Ferocious Inspiration 34460 (+3% damage), also provided by the Retribution Paladin's Communion 31876; nothing is lost. The exotic-pet options (Worm Acid Spit, Rhino Stampede, Core Hound Ancient Hysteria) were never provisioned.
hunter_delta.gained_with_survival: Hunting Party 53290 (10% melee and ranged haste). The shaman's runtime air totem (TryEnsureCombatTotems): an Elemental shaman places Wrath of Air 3738; since 38f4b5770f a raid Restoration shaman places Wrath of Air too when another member has Hunting Party or Improved Icy Talons (BotRaidShamanTotems.h), otherwise Windfury 8512. So Hunting Party is the melee haste of every shard and Wrath of Air the spell haste of every shard.

pet_providers_non_exotic.physical_damage_4pct: Ravager (family 31, Cunning): Ravage 50518. The only non-exotic provider; nobody else in this roster has one (Blood Frenzy is Arms, Savage Combat is Combat rogue, Brittle Bones is Frost DK).
pet_providers_non_exotic.bleed_30pct: Boar (5, Tenacity) Gore 35290 or Hyena (25, Ferocity) Tendon Rip 50271. The Feral tank's Mangle covers it in the four two-tank shards.
pet_providers_non_exotic.crit_5pct: Wolf (1, Ferocity) Furious Howl 24604. Redundant in every shard: Elemental Oath 51470 (Elemental) or Leader of the Pack 17007 (Feral) is always present.
pet_providers_non_exotic.cat: no buff or debuff in these categories

round5_audit.tool: pixi run python -m tools.raid_program.raid_buff_coverage --full (23 WoWSims categories, two columns per shard). provisioned: a member has the provider (known spells of the active spec, talents, pet spells, known totems, raid haste). runtime: an enabled rotation row or a runtime code contract casts it, which is not proof the buff is up. Rotation rows come only from experiments/configs/raid_runtime_actions/blackwing_descent_10n.json (exported from the round 4 evidence artifacts/cata_raid_program/round4_batch1_20260926.tar.gz, md5 1f5b5f109585ec45793ee10ca1464ecc; the tool never reads the world DB); the code contracts are the route readiness list, BotPersistentSelfBuffContract, the raid rogue poison setup, the runtime totems, encounter lust duties and, in a canonical raid, class owner C's round 5 runtime (BotRaidPersistentBuffs.h, BotRaidBossLust.h, BotRaidMajorArmor.h). A talent counts when passive or triggered by a runtime cast, a pet spell when autocast. The JSON action profiles (cata_434_action_profiles.json) only provision. The mask publishes no numeric gates, so each exported row carries gate kinds inferred from its category and observed rejections; a category whose every runtime provider is a gated row or a cast-once readiness buff is a runtime caveat.
round5_audit.round6_nefarian: Round 6 (the user's Nefarian composition: 2 tanks, 2 healers, 6 DPS): the Nefarian shard's shaman is Elemental instead of Restoration. Recomputed with the tool: still 20/20 provisioned and 19/20 runtime (missing +3% damage), with the same caveats. The Elemental shaman now supplies MP5 (Mana Spring), crit (Elemental Oath, besides the Feral tank's Leader of the Pack) and spell haste (Wrath of Air) there; Chimaeron and the full raid keep the Restoration shaman, where Might covers MP5. Nature's Grasp 16689 on the druid is a control spell outside these categories.

declarations_only.note: This composition without C's round 5 runtime (patches 01 and 02): the scores the audit reported before they were integrated.

after.note: With C's round 5 runtime integrated (patches 01 and 02).

round5_audit.changes: Composition: Ravager pet (physical damage taken, autocast Ravage), Power Word: Fortitude on the priest, Faerie Fire on the druid's Balance (770) and Feral tank (16857) groups, Retribution Aura 7294 on the Retribution paladin. C's runtime: Fortitude recast by the priest's persistent row (79105; the readiness row no longer owns it), Blessing of Might in place of Kings under the druid's Mark (attack power % and MP5 in every shard), Devotion Aura on the Holy paladin (armor), Retribution Aura on the Retribution paladin, the boss lust fallback 5 s after the tank holds the boss where no strategy times one (Omnotron, Atramedes, Nefarian and full-raid Magmaw), and the Faerie Fire upkeep rows on bosses (major armor).

provisioned_only.damage_pct_3: Communion 31876 (Retribution) raises party damage through Retribution Aura Overflow 63531, which no script or spell_linked_spell applies in this core; Retribution Aura 7294 is now kept up, but gives only its damage shield. No other roster member has a +3% damage provider.

runtime_caveats.damage_reduction: Scarlet Fever 81132 only through Blood Boil 48721, an aoe row (min_enemies; the Blood test snapshot has min_enemies 2), so a lone boss does not get it. The Feral tank's Demoralizing Roar 99 is provisioned but no row casts it.
runtime_caveats.defensive_cooldowns: Pain Suppression 33206 is an external_defensive row gated by ally health: cast when a member is in danger, as intended.
runtime_caveats.bleed_damage_taken: Feral shards: Mangle 33878 is a single-target row that stops above its max_enemies (observed enemy_count_too_high), so a large add wave pauses the bleed debuff.

round5_audit.runtime_not_provisioned_only: Attack power %: Abomination's Might 53138 (the canonical Blood DK's talent) is a passive SpellEffect 65 raid aura (aura 166, attack power %); its self effect (aura 137, Strength +2%) is in the scoring-start ledger of the DK in all six round 4 shards. Blessing of Might adds the same category now.
round5_audit.open: +3% damage (a core fix applying Retribution Aura Overflow 63531 would credit Communion). Bleed on the Balance shards: Mangle needs the Feral druid; no other provider without an exotic pet or another spec. Re-export the rotation rows from the first live evidence with C's patches (their Faerie Fire rows are raid overrides, which the mask then lists) and publish numeric gates in the mask so the export stops inferring them.

survival_recheck.pet_choice: Ravager, provisioned in round 5 (characters[hunter].pet): the only non-exotic pet that adds a category (4% physical damage taken, missing in every shard); a wolf or cat adds none. Its Cunning talents and spellbook are derived from the DBCs (tools/raid_program/raid_loadout_pet.py) rather than captured on a server; the WoWSims Survival reference still simulates a wolf.

full_raid.rationale: End-to-end clear with one composition: two tanks (Blood DK, Feral druid) and three healers (Holy Paladin, Discipline Priest, Restoration Shaman) cover the two- and three-healer bosses without a mid-run respec. scenario_id is the full-raid route the cohort's own scenario row (route_scenario_id) is cloned from; the cohort gets its own identity block (boss number 99) and a non-diagnostic pool tag, never the legacy blackwing_descent_10n tag.

characters.group_spells_note: Faerie Fire 770 (caster) while Balance and Faerie Fire (Feral) 16857 while the Feral tank is active: the raid's major armor debuff (C's round-5 raid major-armor upkeep casts it; its unknown_requested_spell gate needs the spell in the active group's spellbook). Trainer class spells outside the action profiles, provisioned only with their talent group active (raid_loadout_spells.loadout_known_spells).

characters.spec_note: Survival (user decision 2026-09-26), replacing Beast Mastery. The catalog build is the legacy accepted Magmaw Survival baiter's: Orc (race 2, like the Demonology warlock), talent tree 809 with Hunting Party 53290, glyphs 45731/45732/42898/42904/45735/42899, gear wowsims_cata_p4_survival_hunter, agility flask/food/potion 58087/62669/58145 (its generated prepull contract), action profile survival_hunter, pet: the Ravager declared below (round 5), not the catalog wolf 8959. See buff_coverage_declared.survival_recheck for the pet choice.

pet.pet_note: The canonical hunter's active pet covers the +4% physical damage taken debuff (round 5). Ravage 50518 applies aura 87 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN) on physical at +4, the same effect as the Worm's Acid Spit 55749, the WoWSims provider; Ravager is family 31 (Cunning), its template 26030 (TDB 434.22011) is a tameable beast (type_flags 0x1) without the exotic flag 0x10000, so a Survival hunter tames it (Worm 42 and Rhino 43 are exotic). The spellbook follows the wolf's native save/load shape: the family level-up spells at 85 (SpellMgr::LoadPetLevelupSpellMap: Bite, Ravage, Cower, Growl, Avoidance) plus 17 Cunning talent points (Pet::GetMaxTalentPointsForLevel(85)), checked by tools/raid_program/raid_loadout_pet.py: Serpent Swiftness 2 (pet attack speed), Dash 1 (the Ravager family's variant; a tier-0 point, autocast off), Great Stamina 1, Spiked Collar 3, Boar's Speed 1 (keeps the pet on moving targets), Owl's Focus 2, Feeding Frenzy 2, Great Resistance 3 (15% less magic damage taken, for the raid's fire, shadow and frost AoE), Grace of the Mantis 1 (3% less chance to be critically hit) and Roar of Recovery 1 (30 focus to the hunter). Spiked Collar is a dummy aura with no script in this core, so its 3 points buy only Feeding Frenzy's prerequisite. Not taken: Culling the Herd (its spell_proc -61680 family mask does not match the script's icon check, so it never procs here; its 3 points would only count toward the tier 3 unlock, which the tier 0-1 points already reach), Wolverine Bite (about 1 damage for a pet GCD every 10 s) and Wild Hunt (dummy effects, no script). Autocast 193 on Cower, Growl, Bite, Ravage and Roar of Recovery, 129 (off) on Dash in pet_spell and on the action bar (the bar overrides), 1 for passives; Ravage autocasts, so PetAI casts it natively. Not stat-neutral: the pet_levelstats row (entry 1, level 85) is the same for every family, but the Cunning marker scales the owner's stamina by 0.725 and armor by 0.7 instead of Ferocity's 0.67 and 0.5 (spell_pet.cpp), so the pet is tougher, and the Ferocity damage talents (Spider's Bite, Rabid, Call of the Wild, Shark Attack) are lost, so it deals less damage than the wolf. 4.3.4 has no pet happiness. Canonical roster only: the legacy Magmaw Survival hunter 30009, Stonecore and calibration keep the catalog wolf. The WoWSims Survival reference is simulated with a wolf, so the hunter's own DPS target is not pet-matched.

Hammer of Justice 853: the Nefarian bone-warrior stun this spec was kept for (Nefarian rationale); Cleanse 4987: the Omnotron Soaked In Poison backup dispel (Omnotron duty plan: Holy Paladin Cleanse, then Retribution Cleanse). Shackle Undead 9484: the Nefarian shackler (ControlFor; the Nefarian rationale's Shackle Undead). Encounter duty spell: a trainer class spell outside the action profiles, which only list rotation spells, so it was never provisioned and ExecuteNativeActionIntent refused the duty as an unknown spell. Power Word: Fortitude 21562: the raid's only stamina buff (round 5 coverage audit, tools/raid_program/raid_buff_coverage.py). 21562 is a dummy that applies the raid auras 79104/79105. The route readiness party-buff list (TryValidationRouteReadiness) casts it once the priest knows it, but its aura check names 21562 itself, which no member ever carries, and the cast_once coverage signature then suppresses every recast, so the buff was not restored after a death or a wipe. Round 5 (C, BotRaidPersistentBuffs.h): in a canonical raid the priest's persistent row casts it on itself (always the raid aura 79105) whenever the aura is missing, and the readiness row no longer owns it. Mark of the Wild comes from the persistent self-buff contract, and the paladins bless Might instead of Kings under the druid's Mark.

Encounter duty spell: a trainer class spell outside the action profiles, which only list rotation spells, so it was never provisioned and ExecuteNativeActionIntent refused the duty as an unknown spell. Heroism 32182, the Draenei shaman's raid haste (Bloodlust 2825 is Horde-only), and Water Shield 52127: trainer class spells every level-85 shaman knows, outside the action profiles. The legacy roster declared Heroism per bot, and Magmaw's Bloodlust owner casts it. Water Shield is the healer shaman's persistent self-buff (BotPersistentSelfBuffContract); the restoration profile lists only Lightning Shield, so the round-3 Nefarian c0 Restoration shaman logged persistent_setup_spell_missing:52127 on every setup tick.

bosses.rationale: One tank: Mangle seizes a single Blood DK and the accepted shard kills with one tank and no swap, so the druid is Balance and owns the parasite Wild Mushroom duty. Two healers (Holy Paladin, Discipline Priest): raid damage outside Mangle is light, and the Mangle spike (accepted worst 5 s bucket about 136k, 12%/s of a 202-232k Blood DK) is single-target tank healing that these two cover; accepted kills end in about 100 s, one Mangle cycle. The shaman stays Elemental: it owns Bloodlust for the first exposed-head burn, keeps 19/20 buff coverage and adds a seventh DPS for the bait and chain duties. If a canonical kill loses the tank in a Mangle window, switch the shaman to restoration_shaman (three healers); the capability duty plan then still names that single shaman as the Bloodlust owner.

duty_plan.baiters: Fire Mage (Blink lane) and the Survival Hunter (Disengage lane, any hunter spec). Survival keeps damage up while it moves (instant Explosive Shot, Black Arrow and Arcane Shot); the BM baiter did 14-16k, the legacy Survival baiter 37.6k
duty_plan.chain_riders: two non-baiter DPS without a stationary duty, by GUID: Retribution Paladin and Assassination Rogue
duty_plan.tank_swap: not a Magmaw duty: none with one tank; a two-tank roster swaps only through its route mechanic contract (tank_swap_trigger, read by src/server/game/Bots/BotWorldPopulationMgrValidationRouteManifest.cpp and run by src/server/game/Bots/BotWorldPopulationMgrTankSwap.cpp)
duty_plan.battle_res: not a Magmaw duty: the generic combat-res reconciler (src/server/game/Bots/BotWorldPopulationMgrCombatRes.cpp) picks a caster per death among native combat resurrections (Rebirth 20484, or a resurrect spell under the in-combat resurrection limit); here the Balance Druid's Rebirth (declared, round 5); a canonical raid never makes a tank the owner (38f4b5770f)
duty_plan.source: src/server/game/Bots/Content/Raids/BlackwingDescent/Encounters/Magmaw/BotMagmawDutyCapabilities.h (pull tank, baiters, chain riders, mushrooms, Bloodlust)

bosses.rationale: Two tanks: after the first 45 s two constructs are always active (Activated 90 s, a new one every 45 s on 10N). Two healers (Holy Paladin, Discipline Priest): the pressure is Incineration, Electrical Discharge and Lightning Conductor, and the Holy Paladin carries the poison Cleanse for Soaked In Poison. Elemental keeps Wind Shear in the Arcane Annihilator rotation and a sixth DPS.

duty_plan.tanks: the tank a construct is attacking owns it; a new construct goes to the tank whose construct is gone or shutting down; the owner taunts it back (Dark Command, Growl)
duty_plan.interrupts: Arcane Annihilator rotation by capability and reach: Retribution Rebuke and Assassination Kick, then Elemental Wind Shear, then Blood DK Mind Freeze, then Fire Counterspell, then Feral Skull Bash; backup acts 450 ms into the cast
duty_plan.dispels: Soaked In Poison: Holy Paladin Cleanse, then Retribution Cleanse
duty_plan.bombs: ranged DPS (Survival Hunter, Fire Mage, Elemental, Demonology) kill a Poison Bomb only where its 6 yd blast reaches nobody
duty_plan.bloodlust: no strategy timing (no reviewed release window); round 5: the canonical boss lust fallback (C, BotRaidBossLust.h) has the mage cast Time Warp once the main tank has held a construct for 5 s

bosses.selection_status_note: Requested as final by the Chimaeron agent (round 2); raid_composition accepts only provisional or accepted.
bosses.rationale: Chimaeron agent (round 2): the Break/Double Attack taunt exchange needs two tanks (Blood DK holds Break, Feral soaks Double Attack), and Systems Failure outages need three healers (Holy Paladin tank healer, Discipline Power Word: Barrier, Restoration Spirit Link Totem).

One tank: Atramedes is a single-target fight with no tank swap and Sonic Breath never targets his current victim (spell_atramedes_sonic_breath removes it), so the Blood DK tanks alone and the druid stays Balance. Two healers (Holy Paladin, Discipline Priest): Modulation (31.2-32.8k Shadow in 10N, no Sound) is the only unavoidable raid damage, and Searing Flame is gonged at its start. The shaman stays Elemental for 19/20 buff coverage and a seventh damage dealer. Wowhead's 10-player recommendation is 1 tank, 2 healers, 7 DPS.

duty_plan.tank: main-tank lease or the role tank (Blood DK); drags Atramedes to the ground anchor (150, -224.5)
duty_plan.gong_owner: best ranged damage dealer by gong rank (Survival Hunter: GongRank ranks every hunter spec ahead of the Fire Mage), beside the shield nearest the anchor
duty_plan.gong_backup: next ranged by gong rank (Fire Mage); strikes when the owner is dead or kiting
duty_plan.sonic_breath_kite: whoever carries Tracking from Tracking Flames circles the boss 28-42 yd out, away from the raid
duty_plan.air_kite: whoever carries Tracking from the Reverberating Flame runs the shield ring and strikes a shield in reach when the flame is within 11 yd
duty_plan.bloodlust: no strategy timing (no reviewed release window, reservation stays closed); round 5: the canonical boss lust fallback (C, BotRaidBossLust.h) has the mage cast Time Warp once the main tank has held Atramedes for 5 s
duty_plan.battle_res: the Balance Druid's Rebirth 20484 through the generic combat-res reconciler (BotWorldPopulationMgrCombatRes.cpp); the tank is never the owner

bosses.rationale: Blood DK on Maloriak, Feral holds Aberrations, Prime Subjects and Vile Swills 10+ yd from the boss (Growth Catalyst); two healers because Arcane Storm is interrupted and Remedy dispelled; the Elemental Shaman adds Wind Shear, Purge and phase-two Bloodlust.

bosses.selection_status_note: Requested by the Nefarian agent (round 6) from the user's own raid composition (user raid experience 2026-09-26); raid_composition accepts only provisional or accepted.
bosses.rationale: The user's composition (user raid experience 2026-09-26): 2 tanks, 2 healers, 6 DPS. Two tanks lead Onyxia and Nefarian to opposite ends (Children of Deathwing 50 yd); the raid burns Onyxia from the pull under Bloodlust. The shaman stays Elemental (a sixth DPS for the burn, Wind Shear backup). Two healers cover two pillars in phase 2; the Blood death knight holds the third pillar on its own sustain (BotNefarianDutyPlan.h). The Feral tank, free once Onyxia dies, kites and roots the bone warriors with Nature's Grasp; Shackle Undead is the backup.
